svg.title: Every comparison of the record, rival by rival
svg.desc: 188 comparisons of mixdyn's plans with five rivals' over 38 family-rungs: each dot one family-rung's mean difference in regret per euro, coloured by Hall's reader's word.
svg.text: Each dot is one of the 38 family-rungs: mixdyn’s mean regret per euro less the rival’s, over the simulated worlds both planned.
Its colour is the word of Hall’s reader at one-sided 0.025. Left of 0, mixdyn’s plan lost less; past δ = 0.05, the claim fails.
